questions.query: What is secureWISE?
questions.actual:
secureWISE is a remote equipment monitoring and access system designed to provide greater visibility into equipment uptime and utilization to improve health and functionality. It is architected to deliver secure, end-to-end remote connectivity to equipment over private networks to provide operator visibility into data to drive predictive analytics. Developed in the early 2000s, secureWISE was designed specifically to manage supplier remote connectivity for the semiconductor industry and was built to address the needs of both equipment suppliers and semiconductor manufacturing facilities. The system functions on a “single pane of glass” concept, replacing potentially dozens of separate connections from different equipment suppliers with just one connection through secureWISE. It consists of proprietary software, dedicated hardware, and a managed network.
